sentences.text: Maternity Benefit For Female Workers- JKBOCWWB

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Maternity Benefit for Female Workers" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, is a welfare program that provides maternity benefits to eligible registered female workers up to two times in their lifetime.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance
**Where it applies:** Jammu and Kashmir; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The "Maternity Benefit for Female Workers" scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial assistance to registered female workers during maternity. Under this scheme, female beneficiaries are eligible to receive ₹5,000 (for up to two children), provided they have been engaged in building or construction work for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months.
**Benefits / Assistance:** Under the scheme, maternity benefits for female workers amount to ₹5,000 for up to two children. Note: The benefit is allowed only twice in the beneficiary's lifetime.

**Application Process:** **Registration of a Construction Worker under JKBOCWWB:** Step 1: Go to the J&K Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (JKBOCWWB) [official website.](https://www.jkbocw.gov.in/Index.aspx) Step 2: On the homepage, find and click the "[Labour Registration](https://portal.jkbocw.gov.in/MemberRegistration.aspx)" link. Step 3:If you're a new user, click on "Apply for New Registration." Step 4: Complete the registration form with your details, submit the form, and send the OTP to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP and click "Verify OTP & Submit." Step 5: After the OTP is verified, a confirmation message with your Login ID and password will be sent to your registered mobile number. Step 6:Use the Login ID, password, and captcha to log in (remember, the username and password are case-sensitive). filled are case sensitive)Read all the instruction carefully and Click to continue Step 7: Once logged in, choose the "Construction Worker’s Registration" option and click on "Registration Form." Step 8: A dashboard will appear. Complete the form by entering all required details (marked with *). Step 9: Upload all the important documents, such as ID proof and other relevant certificates. Step 10: Once the form is completed and documents uploaded, click "Submit" and pay the application fee online. You will receive a registration number after successful payment and submission.  **Steps to Apply for Scheme Benefits:** Step1: Go to the [official website](https://www.jkbocw.gov.in/Index.aspx) of the Jammu &amp; Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Step2: Click on &quot;[Login,&quot;](https://portal.jkbocw.gov.in/LoginGuest.aspx) enter your details, and sign in to your account. Step3: After logging in, click on &quot;Scheme Registration&quot; and select &quot;Apply for Scheme.&quot; Step4: Choose the scheme you wish to apply for in order to avail the benefits. Step5: Enter all required information and upload the necessary documents as prompted. Step6: Finally, click on &quot;Submit Application&quot; to complete the process. <br> **Application Tracking:** Applicant can track their application status online through the official website of the Jammu &amp; Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Relevant updates will be sent to the registered mobile number. <br>
